intent: Keep the raw UMI counts of each cell in a layer called counts, then normalise X to 10,000 counts per cell and log-transform it, and finally write per-sample pseudobulk raw-count sums (from the counts layer) for a later count-based differential expression test.
silent_error: adata.layers['counts'] = adata.X stores a reference to the very same array as X (anndata does not copy on assignment; scanpy tutorials and the AnnData.raw docstring therefore write .copy()). normalize_total and log1p then work in place, so the 'counts' layer is silently overwritten with log-normalised values and the pseudobulk table contains sums of log values instead of integer counts. No warning, exit 0; the file looks like a normal pseudobulk table.

files.pseudobulk_prep.py:
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc

adata = sc.read_csv("organoid_counts.csv")
meta = pd.read_csv("organoid_meta.csv", index_col=0)
adata.obs["sample"] = meta.loc[adata.obs_names, "sample"].values

adata.layers["counts"] = adata.X
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(adata)

counts = pd.DataFrame(adata.layers["counts"], index=adata.obs_names, columns=adata.var_names)
pseudobulk = counts.groupby(adata.obs["sample"].values).sum()
pseudobulk.to_csv("pseudobulk_counts.csv")
adata.write_h5ad("organoid_processed.h5ad")
